In Europe's most exclusive residential enclave, Villa Enso establishes a new benchmark for private estate design.

Sited against panoramic mountain backdrops, this 16-bedroom estate pairs seamless indoor-outdoor flow with world-class amenities built for serious car enthusiasts. The subterranean level serves as the residence's crown jewel, housing a full Formula 1 museum featuring genuine race engines, iconic road cars, and a center-stage F1 vehicle.

Adjacent to the collection, an indoor pool and wellness spa allow you to swim alongside your supercars, while a private lounge bar, games suite, and tiered cinema ensure you never have to leave the gates.

Listed with @adam.terrameridiana @terrameridiana

Watch the full tour on The Luxury Home Show YouTube channel.
